people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’ ”
translations.bsb: And the king of Israel replied, “Tell him: ‘The one putting on his armor should not boast like one taking it off.’”
translations.kjv: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
translations.asv: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his armor boast himself as he that putteth it off.
